userStories.title: Blog & Trade Intelligence Administration API
userStories.description: Implement administrative blog endpoints supporting full article lifecycle (draft, published, scheduled, archived), author attribution, cover image, category tagging adhering to the 3 divisions, reading minutes estimation, and audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/blog returns all articles (draft, published, scheduled, archived) with pagination, search, status, and category filtering
GET /api/v1/admin/blog/:id returns article detail with SEO metadata, author profile, and content
POST /api/v1/admin/blog creates new article with slug auto-generation, reading time calculation, and audit log
PUT /api/v1/admin/blog/:id updates article content, author, status, and audit log
DELETE /api/v1/admin/blog/:id deletes or archives article with audit log
PATCH /api/v1/admin/blog/:id/status toggles status between published and draft
RBAC strictly restricts article creation, editing, and deletion to admin and editor roles

userStories.title: Blog & Trade Intelligence Desk UI with Rich Drawer & Live Preview Link
userStories.description: Build complete Blog CMS page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with 4-tab article editor and public site preview link (/blog/:slug)
acceptanceCriteria: Blog page renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Top metric strip displays Total Articles, Published on Site, Drafts in Progress, and Scheduled Publications
FilterBar supports search by title/tags/author, status filter (All, Published, Draft, Scheduled), and category filter
Table displays Article Title with cover thumbnail, Category division badge, Author with designation, Status badge, Read time, Publication Date, and Actions
Detail drawer features 4 focused tabs: 1) Article Core & Content, 2) Author & Taxonomy, 3) Media & Cover Image, 4) SEO & Publishing with live public preview link

userStories.title: Automated Blog Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify blog administration features with integration tests and confirm zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminBlogPosts, fetchAdminBlogPostById, createAdminBlogPost, updateAdminBlogPost, deleteAdminBlogPost, and updateAdminBlogPostStatus
Automated integration tests in server/tests/blog-admin.test.js cover article CRUD, auto read-time estimation, status transitions, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
